verdict.reasoning: The narrative describes a burst supply line (plumbing system) that caused accidental water discharge and damage to inventory. The Named Perils Covered section explicitly includes 'Accidental discharge or leakage from a plumbing, heating, or air-conditioning system' resulting in direct physical damage to insured property. The plumbing contractor confirmed the pipe failure was sudden and accidental, satisfying the policy's requirement. The Exclusions section does not negate this coverage; mechanical breakdown is excluded only where a separate equipment-breakdown endorsement applies, but the policy covers the resulting water damage to other property regardless.
